items.title: File Widerspruch against the Bewilligungsbescheid
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring 6, 65549 Musterlimburg.
items.computation: The letter states 'Versandt am Samstag, 21.11.2026' (the dispatch day) and itself fixes the rule: 'Der Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben.' Counting the 4th day after Sat 21.11.2026: 22.11 (day 1, Sun) - 23.11 (day 2, Mon) - 24.11 (day 3, Tue) - 25.11 (day 4, Wed). So the decision counts as notified (bekannt gegeben) on Wed 25.11.2026 (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then begins the next day, 26.11.2026 (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB i.V.m. § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X), and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of notification, i.e. 25.12.2026 (Friday). That day is 1. Weihnachtstag, a public holiday; the next day, 26.12.2026 (Saturday), is 2. Weihnachtstag, also a holiday; 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. The deadline therefore shifts to the next business day, Monday 28.12.2026 (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB).

items.title: Report as unemployed (sich arbeitslos melden)
items.quote: Melden Sie sich bitte am ersten Tag der Arbeitslosigkeit persönlich oder online arbeitslos, falls noch nicht geschehen.
items.computation: The benefit award explicitly starts 'ab dem 01.01.2027', so the 'first day of unemployment' referred to is 01.01.2027. That day is Neujahr, a nationwide public holiday, so an in-person registration at the Agentur would not be possible that day, but the letter also allows an online registration ('online arbeitslos'), which is not limited by office opening hours. The due date is therefore taken as the stated first day, 01.01.2027, with the caveat that if an in-person visit is needed it would effectively move to the next business day.

items.title: Start of Arbeitslosengeld entitlement (360 days)
items.quote: ab dem 01.01.2027 erhalten Sie Arbeitslosengeld für 360 Kalendertage.
items.computation: The letter fixes the start of the benefit period explicitly as 01.01.2027; no counting is needed.

warnings: The letter's printed decision date (20.11.2026, a Friday) is earlier than the dispatch date it also states ('Versandt am Samstag, 21.11.2026'); the Widerspruchsfrist was computed from the stated dispatch day as the letter's own delivery-fiction clause requires, which gives a later deadline (28.12.2026) than counting from the decision date alone would.

Every name in the letter (Agentur für Arbeit Musterlimburg, Agenturring, Musterquell, Beispielwetzlar, Druckerei Beispiellahn, Landesmusterbank) is a 'Muster/Beispiel' placeholder, suggesting this may be a template or sample document rather than a genuine personal Bescheid; verify authenticity before relying on these dates.

The IBAN printed in the footer (DE18 7600 0000 0004 5550 00) is well-formed and passes the checksum check, but no payment is requested in this letter, so there is no need to use it; do not use it for any payment unless a genuine, separately verified request asks for one.
